method: Offline render on a computer: the module's DSP built into a private OS 1.40C image and run in dsp_host (Mini Verb, E-Verb, Air Chorus, TapeHead), its fixed-point C engine built natively (Tape Echo), or its 808/909 DSP engines in bd909_host (Analog BD). Not recorded on an Octatrack; no firmware or image is included.
